title: Fit the server security bezel and check its latch
instruction: Fit the security bezel and leave its latch checked with both hands clear.
context: Front covers on rack servers have different attachments at their two ends. Correct tab capture, the opposite spring latch and a gentle retention check keep a long cover attached during ordinary service. This task uses an explicitly custom training assembly, not a vendor-matched server or a densely populated rack.
setup: Station bench at747.5mm. Custom430 x44.45 x25mm bezel,350g total, starts upright on its lower edge at(220,0)mm. No added grip handles: hold the25mm-deep top edge at y+/-162.5mm. Target root datum(370,-2,66.675)mm above table; fitted front face x357.5mm. A12U open bench rack has front mounting columns at y+/-232.55mm, ear width482.6mm, top crossbar560mm high, and rear columns at x610mm. The target is the second1U:44.45–88.9mm high, one complete lower unpowered chassis and ten emptyU above. A200 x430mm through-opening in the10mm base keeps the lower chassis floor at the unchanged table datum without overlap. Both chassis have front/roof/floor/side/rear surfaces; front panel is40mm behind the ear datum. Tabs are5 x10 x5mm, right end y=-220mm and z+/-12mm; two side-opening receiver slots have8.75mm fore-aft and8mm vertical clearance dimensions, closed fore/aft walls and15mm insertion depth. The opposite latch has an actual45degree cam nose,8mm spring travel and a square behind-catch retaining face. A visible yellow flag moves in a front window. Four rear locating stops define the final plane. Parts, guide bore, spring seat, pins, mounting/drill pattern and material/assembly instructions are in fixture files and README. No electronics or working server is claimed. Materials: PETG frame, aluminium splice plates if split; PETG/aluminium receiver carriers with steel contact strips and keeper; steel rack and lower/target chassis sheet, tabs, guides, stem and fasteners; spring-steel compression spring, POM latch nose and plastic yellow indicator.
scoring: Only known states with fresh native tick progression on every control observation, stable states with every stock arm collider over5mm clear of the bezel and both grippers/all fingertips additionally over5mm clear of the rack for1s.0.25: both right tabs captured in their actual receiver openings.0.5: additionally all six face samples (local x=-12.5mm,y=-200/0/+200mm,z=+/-18mm) are within2mm fore/aft of x357.5, lateral root y=-2+/-3mm, root height66.675+/-2mm, and tilt at most3degrees. Limits are inclusive with1micrometre positional/1microradian angular numerical allowance; finite tab capture must independently pass.1.0: visible latch extension is within1mm of its outward stop and an actual native persistent10N outward pull has lasted1s without either end escaping or any observed face point moving over2mm in full3D Euclidean displacement. Proof time integrates queried physics dt from native steps reading the actual applied force buffer. Native face displacement is sampled during the load. Unknown native data, a failed pull or stock finger load over40.01N gives0. The real check uses a spring balance and ruler/feeler gauge, not hidden catch overlap or an all-link force threshold. Tab capture separately allows100micrometres at the x/z slot boundaries and outer y back wall; the5mm minimum insertion-depth gate has no added allowance.
fidelity: Custom fabricated hardware, not vendor-accurate. Rigid printed frame, steel receiver envelopes and a POM spring-slide latch approximate a buildable training assembly. Spring rate/preload, masses, friction and rigid-body stiffness are specified design estimates, not measured prototype results. Electronics, lock/key security and dense-rack access are not claimed. A native persistent force models the operator's spring-balance retention check.
scores: Scripted demo: 1.0. Ordinary Dream-1: 0.0 after 1000 steps. Native demo proof: 10 N outward for 1 s (240 samples), max movement 0.520 mm, datum error 1.285 mm, peak finger/tip load 8.227 N. Fixed layout, environment seed 42. Simulation only.
reset_notes: Pull the visible flag inward to retract the latch, swing the opposite end forward, slide the right tabs out, and place the bezel upright at its marked start. Confirm spring return, clean dry guides, unchanged stops and clear arms. Use the logged Isaac Lab environment seed42, fixed layout and object_jitter0; no parts start engaged.
